body:
Recovered STORY-1889's hold/defer slice (PR 2 of 4) on top of current main in non-completing PR #2917 (https://github.com/joemooney/aida/pull/2917, branch claude/story-1889-hold-r2 at 76e718a95eb25630d090ae9cc3b9b0b78cc99ce7, old claude/story-1889-hold branch preserved untouched).

Scope (per advisor rulings 01a1655f & 01a1658c):
- defer_cmd.rs operator-hold refusal and seat checks -> gate/operator_hold.rs; queue_cmd.rs hold checks call operator_hold_refusal.
- auto_complete::is_branch_policy_merge_refusal -> gate/branch_policy.rs.
- merge_hold.rs split: record types, hold read path, marker write/clear path, BUG-2214 human_recorded_clearance / human_attested_release, and hold decisions -> gate/merge_hold_core.rs; forge labels, pinned-change reads, and stray-marker adoption remain in merge_hold.rs.
- merge_hold.rs drops off GATE_PROTECTED_PATHS (covered by gate/ prefix); story_1700_drive_mandate_tests::pr_touching_gate_paths_is_gated updated.
- merge_hold inline tests split into gate/tests/merge_hold_core_tests.rs (+ bug_2176_merge_hold_primary_root_tests.rs) and src/tests/merge_hold_tests.rs.
- KNOWN_UNPROTECTED 5 -> 3.
- Before/after refusal-string inventory attached to PR #2917 body (zero refusal string changes).
- Gates: 154 targeted unit tests, make check-ci-fast (34/34), make test-touched (1,503 passed), and make check-ci-compile all green.

Proceeding next to the final STORY-1889 approval/ship PR stacked on top of claude/story-1889-hold-r2.
subject: STORY-1889 hold/defer recovery PR #2917 ready for review
